acceptanceCriteria: A ticket mutation attaches evidence digests and a reason to an OPEN ticket and produces a receipt.
The mutation leaves the record, acceptanceRevision, status and gate state unchanged, proved by a focused test comparing the record before and after.
ticket show lists attached evidence, and receipt audit stays CONSISTENT after the write.
The spec and docs/TASKS-EXTERNAL-AGENTS.md document the verb and its payload.
body: Observed 2026-10-05 (installed corvint-tasks, orchestrator session): a peer session asked to add evidence to V1-0325 and keep it OPEN until full-gate is green. The installed ticket verbs are create, refine, prioritize, set-dependencies, set-gates, set-effects, hold, release-hold, reopen, archive, restore, complete-manual, grant-approval and revoke-approval. None records evidence alone: refine rewrites owner-authored record fields (body, acceptanceCriteria) and changes acceptanceRevision, and complete-manual changes status. Expected: a journal-backed, receipted write that attaches evidence digests and a short reason to an OPEN ticket, leaves record, acceptanceRevision and status unchanged, and is shown by ticket show and checked by receipt audit. Actual: no such write; evidence for partly-done tickets lives only in PRs and build logs and is invisible to ticket show.

completion.reason: Owner accepted V1-0808 with qualification NOT_RUN on 2026-10-05 and delegated its design questions; orchestrator accepted the drafted TEA-V0-001 defaults. No unrun witness is reported as passed; make gate and tests outside the focused set are NOT_RUN.

title: corvint-tasks: append evidence to an OPEN ticket without changing its record or status
